title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Co-Lessees, Deputies and Box Keys
content:
Besides the lessee, a rental of one of the bank's Safe Deposit Boxes can list other people who may use the box, and each rental comes with a fixed set of keys. This page covers how many people can be listed, how the list is changed, and what the bank does when keys go missing.

## Limits by box size

| Box size | Co-lessees allowed | Deputies allowed | Keys handed over when the lease begins |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | up to 1 | up to 2 | 2 |

## Changing who is listed

A co-lessee may be added or removed, and deputies named or dropped, solely on an instruction the lessee personally signs. Nobody else, including a co-lessee or a deputy, can alter the list. Adding a co-lessee is charged at the co-lessee add fee for the size. However the list changes, a rental never ends up with more than one co-lessee or more than two deputies.

## Lost and missing keys

- **Some keys lost.** When a key is lost, the lock has to be changed, and the rental is charged the lock-change fee for the size as a lock-change service charge.
- **Every key lost.** When no key remains, the box is drilled at the drilling fee for the size and its lock is changed at the lock-change fee, so both charges fall on the rental.
- **No copies.** The bank never makes a duplicate of a box key, whatever the reason given.

## Points of judgement

- *A lessee wants to add a second deputy while one is already named.* Two deputies is within the limit, and such a change rests on the lessee's own signed instruction.
- *A co-lessee asks to name a deputy.* The list changes only on the lessee's own signed instruction, so the co-lessee's request alone does not change it.
- *A lessee with a rental that already has a co-lessee wants to add a second one.* The limit is one co-lessee per rental, so a second cannot be added.
- *One of the two keys is lost and the lessee asks for a spare to be cut.* Keys are never duplicated; a lost key calls for a lock change at the size's lock-change fee.
